:::{#def-perplexity}
#### Perplexity

The **perplexity** of a
[discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$
is the [exponential](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-exponential-function)
of its [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy),
with the same base as the
[logarithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-logarithm) in the entropy:

$$\perplexityf{X} \eqdef b^{\entropyf{X}}.$$

With base-2 [logarithms](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-logarithm), $\perplexityf{X} = 2^{\entropyf{X}}$ with $\entropyf{X}$ in [bits](#def-bit).
With [natural logarithms](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-natural-log),
$\perplexityf{X} = \euler^{\entropyf{X}}$ with $\entropyf{X}$ in [nats](#def-nat).
The two give the same value.

:::
